title: The Library shelf picker keeps its segments when the Brushes shelf is offered
goal: With the Brush in hand the Library offers five shelves (Media, Comps, Brushes, Styles, Systems), and at the dock's resting width they no longer fit side by side, so the picker turns into a dropdown. The mock draws it as segments; make all five fit as segments at the resting width.
notes: Found by brushes-are-picked-from-a-library-of-tiles-that (2026-10-25). LibraryScope.scopes(hasTime:brushes:) adds .brushes after .components only while EditorState.libraryOffersBrushes (Brush in hand). The drawn SegmentedControl (fallsBackToSystem: false) falls back to its dropdown when the words do not fit: 236pt dock, words Media Comps Brushes Styles Systems. Options: tighter segment padding for five, shorter words, or icons with the words in tips. Picture: queue/audits/2026-10-25-brush-library-shelf.png (the Brushes dropdown). brush-library.html draws Media | Brushes | Styles | Systems (no Comps, which a later mock added).
acceptance: With the Brush in hand and the dock at its resting width, the Library's shelf picker shows all five shelves as segments, every word whole
With any other tool in hand the picker is exactly as it was: four segments
A walk with no flags clicks the Brushes segment at a point on its face and the brush tiles show
